notes.title: 2022 Chip Pack Price Changes
notes.notes:
To our Four Kings players,

Beginning on September 12th, 2022, the price of chip packages will be increasing on all platforms. Since The Four Kings Casino and Slots launched in 2015, we have continued to maintain the same chip package prices we launched with. Due to a variety of market forces out of our control, we are reluctantly adjusting our pricing to continue to provide you with a consistent gaming experience.

Players will have from now until September 12th to buy chips at their current price before the new pricing structure takes effect. On average, there will be a 10% increase for all chip packages available from the Cashier. All other in-game purchases will maintain their current prices, including clothing items and Emporium store items. VIP levels will continue to grant extra bonus chips from purchases based on your VIP level, up to 15% additional chips for VIP 3 players.

Thank you for your continued support.

notes.title: 2018 Year in Review + What's Next
notes.notes:
[h1]Year in Review[/h1]

The past year brought with it a host of new changes to the Four Kings Casino. Among the highlights of the year, we released two entirely new games, the all new Emporium store, and revamped the casino's layout and look. 

Here's a quick rundown of the most notable updates to the Four Kings experience from this year:

•    Added a new way to play poker with Ring Poker 
•    Totally revamped the casino's Lobby 
•    Added the Winds of Fortune slots, with a unique combo chain element
•    Introduced official Four Kings merch 
•    Emporium store added, alongside new items: the Poker Party Pack, Reward Points Tripler, and the Daily Super Slots Booster Pack 
•    Added the ability to win any Lucky Fountain rewards you've missed 
•    Re-released the 2017 Jackpot Pack items in the Royal Reserve 
•    Upgraded the game engine
•    Added Nobility Levels 11-15, including the new Emporium Grab Bag rewards and a new cyberpunk-themed outfit 
•    Several new clothing and item releases, including Jackpot Pack rewards
•    All kinds of changes and fixes under the hood

We'd like to thank all of our players for their support and feedback throughout the year. We're happy with what we accomplished in 2018 for the Four Kings Casino & Slots and we plan on making the game even better in the upcoming year.


[h1]A Look Ahead at 2019[/h1]

We've got lots of exciting things in the pipeline, and while we can't discuss all of them just yet, we can shed some light on some things to look forward to in 2019.

With the New Year, comes an all-new design for the year’s Leaderboard Jackets. Earn your way to the top of the Leaderboards and you’ll receive 2019’s fresh new designs to show off your status!

We’ve already released our first new game for 2019 with the Gold Rush slot machine! This machine features the ability to pass on a bonus round for a bigger jackpot later on, and comes with its own unique achievements and rewards.

Going forward, we’re planning on readjusting the distribution of RP between different types of games, which should improve things for those who prefer to play games other than Poker.

And as always, you can expect regular new item releases throughout the year and monthly Jackpot Pack and Lucky Fountain rewards!

We'll leave you with a first look at the new Leaderboard Jackets for 2019! The Top 10 placers for the leaderboard will be the first to rock these exclusive jackets after the current season wraps up at the end of February.

notes.title: Our Biggest Update Ever - All New Lobby!
notes.notes:
Our Biggest Update Ever!

The Casino floor has been under heavy renovation for the last few months and we're ready to open the doors. Our fresh Lobby update will provide a positively stellar gaming experience. This complete redesign will improve performance while providing new intimate gaming areas. We've also made all your favorite stores like Trends, Masquerade and Suited easier to browse. Find them just outside the new Club entrance and put on a fresh new outfit before dancing the night away.

Once you're done checking out the new Lobby space, head over to the Poker and Blackjack Rooms. Both spaces have been redesigned with your playing style in mind. And yes - we've even added in additional Tournament Poker Tables!

Also new this Spring - Blackjack and Slot Tournament Events will now be held in the Event Room! When these are events are active, simply load up the Map and warp to the Event Room, where you can play directly with all of your fellow competitors.

This is just the first of many new updates we plan for 2018 so make sure you follow us on [url=www.facebook.com/fourkingscasino]Facebook[/url] and on [url=www.twitter.com/digitalleisure]Twitter[/url] for the latest.

We've been listening to all your comments, so keep an eye out for new games, clothing and rewards coming soon!

Thanks again for your continued support!

Good Luck and Have Fun!

notes.title: Update 1.052 - Poker Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Version 1.052[/h1]
We are pleased to announce the rollout of the much anticipated ability to reconnect to an in-progress poker game if accidentally disconnected.  Any player disconnected from the table will be able to rejoin his/her table as long as his/her chips are still in play.   Please note, if you disconnect from the table using ESC, no reconnection options will be available.

[h1]What to Expect After A Poker Disconnection:[/h1]

The disconnected player will attempt to reconnect and his/her chips will remain in play.  Small and large blinds will be automatically paid, and the player will automatically check if the check option is available.  The hand will fold to any chip increase that would normally require player intervention (such as a bet or raise).  It is possible that if a player has the big blind, and no one raises during the hand, for the player to win a hand while disconnected.  [b]If the player runs out of chips while disconnected then he/she will not see the option to rejoin the table upon reconnection.[/b]  Running out of chips during the reconnection process will also halt the reconnection and the player will no longer be able to rejoin the table.

[h1]Reconnection Process In Game:[/h1]

Once the player logs back in, he/she will be automatically transported back to the poker table.  It will NOT be possible to go anywhere other than the poker table.  Attempts to teleport to any other location will result in being transported back to the poker table.  Once at the poker table, the icon above the table will say “Wait”.  Once the hand currently in progress completes, the icon will then provide the option to “Join”.  Once the player elects to join, a blue box will appear that says “Waiting” while the next hand plays out.  Once that second hand plays out, the player will be seated at the table, and play will resume.


Thank you to all those who assisted in the beta testing of this function. If you experience any issues during the reconnection process, please provide as much detail as possible via a bug report or forum post so we may review and correct it.

notes.title: Update 1.018
notes.notes:
[h1]Major Slot Update[/h1]

[b]Spinning Cogs Released![/b]
It's your duty to take down the enemy airships and earn big bonuses. When the three Scatter Airships appear on your board, prepare to fire up your weapons. But watch out for Steambots - or your bonus round is sunk.

[b]888 Slots Bonus Round Payout Error[/b]
This issue affects ~250 active 888 Slot users. If you are not an active slot player, you can likely ignore.

On Monday June 29th, a bug was introduced during the V1.017 patch at 18:00 EDT. The bug caused the player to be re-awarded all previous slot session winnings upon achieving a 888 Bonus round. This doubled all of the session winnings - something that should not have occurred. The bug was reported by a small number of users and we began to investigate. Upon discovering the true nature of the bug and irregular payouts, we had no choice but to shut down the game servers. 

The following updates must now instituted to ensure the fairness and continuity of the game.
[list]
[*]New players - those who started playing the game for the first time following Monday's update - will have their slot winnings capped at 25,000 chips.[/*]

[*]Existing players who earned chips while playing the slots during this error period will have their winning chips capped at 100,000. All others that earned below 100,000 chips during this period will keep what they won.[/*]

[*]All RP gained will be kept as earned for all players. This will not be deducted due to the error.[/*]

[*]The Slots Leaderboard has been reverted to the state prior to Monday's update, and all Global earnings from Slot gains have also be reverted.[/*]

[*]Accounts which had earned the Level 40 Slots Steampunk outfit after Monday's update, no longer have this item in inventory. (This affected ~6 users).[/*]
[/list]

[b]Other Fixes/Updates:[/b]
[list]
[*]False Bingo calls take half the time to restart the game[/*]
[*]Level 40 Slots Item Released - Steampunk Outfit[/*]
[*]Keno ball now highlights on hit[/*]
[*]Additional Poker tables added to Poker Room[/*]
[*]Additional Blackjack tables added to Blackjack Room[/*]
[*]Sever stability updates[/*]
[/list]

[b]Known Issue:[/b]
[list]

[/list]

notes.title: Release v1.000
notes.notes:
[h1]Release v1.000[/h1]
The Four Kings Casino is finally live! We’d like to thank everyone who participated in our early access beta for helping us get to this point.

In the Four Kings you will find several games on the main floor, like Roulette, Craps and War. Blackjack and Poker are in the adjoining rooms on the left and right. Slots and other machine games are spread throughout the floor.

Use your chips to play games. As you play games, you will earn Reward Points (RP) to buy prizes from the stores on the upper level. If you need more chips there are several ways you can earn them for free, or you can purchase more from the Chip Terminal or Cashier store.

If you have any questions, press ENTER to start chatting with other players, or you can post a discussion on our Steam Community page. In the discussion board you will also find all our patch notes from Early Access.

Good luck, and have fun!

notes.title: Early Access ends June 1st
notes.notes:
Dear Four Kings Guests,

We’re excited to announce that The Four Kings: Casino & Slots is coming out of Early Access on June 1! Thank you for all of your support and feedback; we wouldn’t be ready to launch without it. This will also be the last week to pick up any of the Founders DLC Passes. These passes can give you up to $20.00 in bonus chips, VIP Access, and exclusive items when the game launches! You can read about these passes on this discussion board.

On the morning of June 1st we’ll be taking the casino servers down for pre-release maintenance. During this time all of your account data will be reset – chips, RP, clothing and stats. Items which were purchased as part of the DLC packs offered on Steam, and any exclusive bonus badges awarded during our Early Access will be restored to your account when you log back in on June 1st. The Crown Jewels store will officially open, and the Chip Packs will be available for purchase. As with any online experience, there are still going to be some rough edges and we will be fixing and updating the game on a regular basis. As always, check these forums for all the details and if issues arise, feel free to reach out. 

Thank you again for your continued support. We’ll see you in The Four Kings!

Your friends at Digital Leisure Inc.

notes.title: Patch Notes v0.9026
notes.notes:
[h1]Patch Notes v0.9026[/h1]
[b]The day the numbers changed.[/b]
We’ve made a change to all the limits within the Casino. Everything will be 10x the value it was before. From a balance perspective, this doesn’t really affect things – games will cost 10x as much, but you also have 10x as many chips. We’re making this change because based on some feedback we’ve received, users didn’t feel like the limits were high enough. Originally when designing the game, we thought that going into a casino and dropping $200 a hand was a lot, we felt each chip was pretty valuable and even winning 100-200 chips was rewarding. While that may be the case in real life, we want to make this feel a bit more like a game. So now anyone can walk in and start betting thousands of chips/hand, with the limits in VIP reaching up to 10,000. Functionally everything should be the same, but we feel this is more fun and rewarding.

This change does affect a lot of areas throughout the casino though, so it’s possible we missed something. If you notice something hasn’t been properly scaled, please report a bug or post in the discussion area of our community hub. We’d also love to hear your feedback on the new system.
Some things to look out for:
[list]	[*]Chip models have updated to reflect the new chip values, so make sure the chips you bet correspond to the chips on the table[/*]	[*]RP will still be earned at the same rate for each game (i.e. not multiplied by 10).[/*]	[*]Make sure you’re being awarded the appropriate chip values from things like gifts, daily slot spins and free chips.[/*]	[*]Make sure you’re being paid out correctly on bets.[/*]	[*]Make sure your holdings are correct[/*]	[*]Purchasing chips should also be multiplied by 10x.[/*][/list]

[b]The day the numbers changed.[/b]
We’ve made a change to all the limits within the Casino. Everything will be 10x the value it was before. From a balance perspective, this doesn’t really affect things – games will cost 10x as much, but you also have 10x as many chips. We’re making this change because based on some feedback we’ve received, users didn’t feel like the limits were high enough. Originally when designing the game, we thought that going into a casino and dropping $200 a hand was a lot, we felt each chip was pretty valuable and even winning 100-200 chips was rewarding. While that may be the case in real life, we want to make this feel a bit more like a game. So now anyone can walk in and start betting thousands of chips/hand, with the limits in VIP reaching up to 10,000. Functionally everything should be the same, but we feel this is more fun and rewarding.

This change does affect a lot of areas throughout the casino though, so it’s possible we missed something. If you notice something hasn’t been properly scaled, please report a bug or post in the discussion area of our community hub. We’d also love to hear your feedback on the new system.
Some things to look out for:
[list]	[*]Chip models have updated to reflect the new chip values, so make sure the chips you bet correspond to the chips on the table[/*]	[*]RP will still be earned at the same rate for each game (i.e. not multiplied by 10).[/*]	[*]Make sure you’re being awarded the appropriate chip values from things like gifts, daily slot spins and free chips.[/*]	[*]Make sure you’re being paid out correctly on bets.[/*]	[*]Make sure your holdings are correct[/*]	[*]Purchasing chips should also be multiplied by 10x.[/*][/list]
[b]Other changes this patch:[/b]
[list]	[*]Users with new accounts should be randomly assigned a UI color[/*]	[*]The game should adjust resolutions a little more cleanly now[/*]	[*]Fixed a bug where you sometimes could not add a friend by name until you selected someone on your friends list[/*]	[*]Fixed an issue where settings were not sticking. If you find settings changing randomly changing, please take note and file a bug report.[/*]	[*]Fixed some issues around gifting a guest pass. You can send a VIP guest pass to your friends via the cash terminal[/*]	[*]Fixed some issues loading categories in the store.[/*]	[*]Fixed some issues around block-list logic[/*]	[*]Fixed an issue where the message of the day would not always be the most recent MOTD[/*]	[*]Fixed a number of issues regarding tournaments[/*][/list]
[b]Known Issues:[/b]
[list]	[*]X/Y Inversion may not be set correctly when you first start the game.[/*]	[*]Task Tracker does not properly scroll to read the whole task.[/*][/list]
[b]Localization:[/b]
[list]	[*]We’ve started localizing in Greek![/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes v0.9019
notes.notes:
[h1]Patch Notes v0.9019[/h1]
Hey guys, sorry about the long time between updates, but we’ve got a pretty big update this time around. We’re back at full strength here and making progress in several areas of the Casino.

[h1]Hotel Room![/h1]
We’ve added a hotel room which can be accessed by using the elevator to the right of the Casino entrance. Keep in mind this hotel room is in a [b]VERY EARLY[/b] state. The lights are not correct, and it is NOT optimized, so we expect performance to be poor.
[list]	[*]You can join your friends in a hotel room by using the friends menu.[/*]	[*]Hotel rooms are currently limited to 8 users at once. [/*]	[*]If you try and join a hotel room that’s full a small warning message will appear in the top right.[/*]	[*]If the owner of the hotel room leaves, other users should be removed from the hotel room.
Please report any bugs related to the hotel room using our bug reporting feature![/*][/list][h1]Lighting[/h1]
We’ve updated a lot of the underlying mechanics for our lighting system within the Casino. This is good because it will allow us more power and flexibility in the future, but currently the lights look a little bit off.
[list]	[*]Casino is a bit darker than we intended[/*]	[*]Some 2D art (UI, 2D Games) may appear washed out or off-color. Please report these as you see them using our bug reporting feature.[/*]	[*]This color problem particularly affects the Wardrobe.
We’re in the process of further updating our tools, so the lighting and will change moving forward.[/*][/list][h1]Friends[/h1][list]	[*]The friends menu is implemented and should more or less be feature complete. Please try joining your friends and accepting friend requests using the menu system.[/*]	[*]Invite functionality currently just tells you that someone wants you to go to them. In the future we will have a way to accept invites directly.[/*]	[*]Friend requests just pop up a message dialogue which has to be dismissed. In the future we’ll have a dialogue where you can directly accept the request, but for now you’ll have to use the friends menu.[/*][/list][h1]Other Notes[/h1][list]	[*]We fixed an error in timekeeping, so events should work again![/*]	[*]Fixed a bug where users using the map to go to VIP would sometimes fall through the world.[/*]	[*]The menu should frame your avatar now when opening.[/*]	[*]Some controller fixes.[/*]	[*]Various behind the scenes server fixes.[/*]	[*]Mouse cursor will now be hidden when rotating your character using the right-mouse-button.[/*][/list][h1]Known Issues[/h1][list]	[*]Known issue: Things are way too transparent now, making it difficult to read chat and other dialogue boxes.[/*]	[*]Stats display in roulette is currently broken[/*][/list]
[b]As a reminder, chips are FREE for early access! You will receive a confirmation email, but you WILL NOT be charged.[/b]

We value your feedback, so please leave us a [b]review[/b]. This will also help others discover our game!

For more updates follow us on social media!
